metadata.dataset: NCTA trail alerts (alert points), national — no geographic clip
metadata.date_note: date_ms is the service's stored instant verbatim; date is its America/Chicago calendar date (the service stores UTC midnight of the following day — see pull_trail_alerts_national.py).
metadata.clip_method: Envelope selection over the national trail envelope (object-id fetch, chunk-verified); no Minnesota or chapter clip; positions from GeoJSON geometry requested with outSR=4326

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Milton Lake Rd.
properties.description: The segment along Milton Lake Rd may be underwater and deep enough to prevent vehicle access to Trailhead. The road has a gravel bottom but exercise caution when crossing. Hikers may need to use the bypass trail following Milton Lake Dr, CR-52 and FR2321

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Magnolia, OH

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Crown Point State Historic Site
properties.location: Trail Alert - Crown Point State Historic Site
properties.description: The Crown Point State Historic Site is currently undergoing a Unit Management Plan update. The proposed NCNST route which traverses the old fort ramparts has been submitted for approval in this process. Until then, use Grandview Drive as the NCNST route.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - State Game Lands 95
properties.description: The NCT north and south of Pry Rd will be closed on Tuesday Feb. 14, 2023 due to an annual controlled burn by the Pa. Game Commission

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Heart of the Lakes Trail
properties.location: Trail Alert - Heart of the Lakes Trail
properties.description: The NCT now follows the Heart of the Lakes paved multi-use trail which lies adjacent to the roads.  This NCT segment is not yet signed.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Lake Vermilion State Park
properties.location: Trail Alert - Lake Vermilion State Park
properties.description: In Lake Vermilion State Park, there are backcountry campsites (fee required) just off the NCT's route on the Mesabi Trail.  See https://files.dnr.state.mn.us/maps/state_parks/spk00285.pdf

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Adirondack Park
properties.description: Large flooded area.  Alt. route available to the north.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Deer Creek Crossing
properties.description: Near Shippenville, the Trail goes through PA SGL 63 where it traverses Deer Creek and there are no structures for passage. This crossing may be dangerous due to the changing water levels, especially during spring runoff or after significant storm events.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Johnnycake Run
properties.description: The NCT goes through the Tracy Ridge system of ANF where it traverses both Johnnycake and Tracy Run. Currently there are no structures for passage.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Tracy Run

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Mellen
properties.description: The City of Mellen will be replacing the highway bridge starting in June, necessitating a detour this summer.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Superior Hiking Trail - Split Rock River Loop
properties.location: Trail Alert - Superior Hiking Trail - Split Rock River Loop
properties.description: The eastern side of the Split Rock River Loop will close September 1 and impact 1.8 miles of the main SHT corridor. This project is designed to allow trail users to easily bypass the closed trail section using temporary reroutes.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Trail Alert - Superior Hiking Trail - Bean and Bear Loop
properties.location: Trail Alert - Superior Hiking Trail - Bean and Bear Loop
properties.description: The Bean and Bear Lakes Loop closure will begin May 15 and impacts 2.2 miles of the main SHT corridor.  This project is designed to allow trail users to easily bypass the closed trail section using temporary reroutes.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Rochert, MN
properties.description: The NCT is currently flooded south of the Otter Tail River ford where it goes around a private land cornerpost.  The water may be up to 12" deep.  Note: this flooded spot is between the white- blazed ford bypass trail and the river ford.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Downtown Delphos
properties.description: Ongoing structural maintenance on Lock 23 results in a temporary trail closure starting at Third Street. Trail users should use the following directions and can expect the detoured trail to be blazed on the ground.

The NCT is now complete from CR-17 west to True Road but this is currently a dead-end segment.  The Arrowhead Chapter has cleared the corridor south of True Road and built a 200' puncheon but the trail corridor is not mowed and the tread is not finished.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Gunflint Trail
properties.description: A new segment of the NCT was built in May that connects the Kekekabic Trail with the Border Route Trail directly across CR-12 (Gunflint Trail).  The old Kekekabic Trail out to CR-12 is now a spur to the trailhead parking area.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Lonetree WMA - prairie restoration
properties.description: ND Game & Fish is doing a prairie restoration here that should be complete in 2029 - now it's planted to row crops. Hikers should follow the mowed detour south of the field and then along its eastern edge.

properties.title: Trail Alert - Citrus Road

properties.title: Trail Alert: Brevort Dam Rd

properties.title: Trail Alert: Douglas County Wildlife Area (Bird Sanctuary)

properties.title: Trail Alert: Waboose Lake
properties.location: Waboose Lake, Paul Bunyan State Forest
properties.description: The campsite and adjacent trail was recently vandalized with graffiti.  It is currently being addressed by the Minnesota DNR and the ITM Chapter hopes that it will be rehabbed soon.  Please know that the graffiti is very inappropriate and is pervasive.

properties.title: Trail Alert: McClusky and New Rockford Canals
